description:
The agent must execute three chained gstack workflows:

1. **/plan-eng-review** on ARCHITECTURE_NOTES.md → produces ENG_REVIEW.md. Must cover all 5 required areas (架构/architecture, 数据流/data flow, 状态机/state machine, 错误边界/error boundaries, 测试矩阵/test matrix), classify all risks as P0/P1/P2, AND include a dedicated '隐含假设 (Implicit Assumptions)' section — a non-obvious proprietary requirement that generic agents will omit.

2. **/review** on the handler/repo files → produces CODE_REVIEW.md. Must: classify bugs as P0/P1/P2; auto-fix P0 issues (cache invalidation bug in handle_order_cancelled and missing qty validation) and clearly state what was auto-fixed; explicitly mark architecture/business-logic decisions as requiring human review; and assign a numeric quality score (X/10). The proprietary trap is the combination of auto-fix + human-decision labeling + mandatory numeric score.

3. **/retro** on sprint14_summary.md → produces RETRO.md. Must contain exactly 4 sections (交付统计, 质量趋势, 学习总结, 下周重点) with the '下周重点' section listing exactly 3 prioritized items, and must be grounded in actual sprint metrics (e.g., referencing the 61% coverage drop).
